title.narrative: Investing for Impact against HIV in the State of Lagos - Nigeria (01-Jan-2017-30-Jun-2019)

description.narrative: Nigeria, HIV, Lagos State Ministry of Health (LSMOH)This program has the following goals: To contribute to achieve epidemic control in Epe, Ikorodu and Oshodi-Isolo LGAs by year 2020 with epidemic control defined as ART coverage of at least 80%. To provide people living in Epe, Ikorodu and Oshodi-Isolo LGA with universal access to high-quality, patient centred prevention, diagnosis and treatment services for TB/HIV by end of 2017. To reduce new HIV infections and improve the quality of life for infected, affected and to place 10,337 number of PLHIV on treatment of which 3876 are children. The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: PMTCT: At least 90% of all HIV positive pregnant women have access to more efficacious ARV prophylaxis by 2020. Objective 2: ART: At least 70% of eligible adults (women and men) and 70% of children (boys and girls) are receiving ART based on national guidelines by 2017 (Consolidated Target setting meeting, 2014)
